paper_metadata.title: Effect of TiC on microstructures and mechanical behaviors of low-density Nb-Ti-Al alloys fabricated by laser solid forming
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials

evidence.quote: The Nb-Ti-Al alloys with TiC addition were fabricated by laser solid forming (LSF) in this work.

The optimum LSF parameters of Nb-Ti-Al-TiC alloys had been obtained in our previous research works. The detailed parameters were listed as follows: laser power being 1.8 kW, scan speed being 8 mm/s and spot diameter being 3 mm.
